clues: This town is the second town of its state, on the east part of a high rock plain. Its folk count was past eight hundred thousand at the last full count.
Heat peaks in May here, at the end of a long hot spring. Then the wet wind comes, with rains from June to September.
This town was the seat of a great house of kings, set up in 1163. Their forts, lakes, and stone gates still stand.
A stone gate of its old kings sits on the crest of its state. Folk call this town the culture heart of the state.
This town is one of three towns that fuse as one great town. A long high road links the three parts.
